title: Claim-Level Reliability Assessment for Efficient Test-Time Reasoning
abstract: arXiv:2608.11994v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: We propose claim-level falsification as a principle for test-time scaling and instantiate it through Claim-Level Reliability Assessment (CLR), a training-free framework that reallocates test-time compute from additional solution sampling to targeted verification. Since whole-trace evaluation often obscures decisive errors due to signal dilution from routine tokens, CLR condenses each reasoning trace into a compact set of decision-critical claims, thereby isolating its logical anchors. Furthermore, recognizing the inherent difficulty of generating entirely correct solutions under fixed model capabilities, CLR shifts the focus to semantic falsification. This approach exploits a fundamental asymmetry between solution construction and claim refutation. translated_title: 基于声明级可靠性评估的高效测试时推理
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.11994v1 公告类型：新 摘要：我们提出将声明级证伪作为测试时扩展的原则，并通过声明级可靠性评估（CLR）框架实例化，这是一个无需训练的框架，将测试时计算从额外的解决方案采样重新分配到有针对性的验证中。由于整体轨迹评估常因常规标记的信号稀释而掩盖关键错误，CLR将每条推理轨迹压缩为紧凑的决策关键声明集合，从而隔离其逻辑锚点。此外，鉴于在固定模型能力下生成完全正确解决方案的固有难度，CLR将重点转向语义证伪。这种方法利用了解决方案构建与声明反驳之间的基本不对称性：构建有效解决方案需要无懈可击的推理路径，而反驳错误声明只需识别一个决定性的缺陷。这种针对负面证据的定向搜索……
tldr: 该论文提出CLR框架，通过将推理轨迹压缩为关键声明并利用语义证伪不对称性，重新分配测试时计算以提升推理效率，无需额外训练。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes the CLR framework, which condenses reasoning traces into key claims and leverages semantic falsification asymmetry to reallocate test-time compute for efficient reasoning without training.
